preconditions.description: Attacker must be an authorized address (owner or authorized account) to call performairdrop function
Attacker must have some balance of the MetaApes token (0xd764457Fadd15B52089BeE2b3c38964C7dFf0B70) to use as 'from' address in airdrop

exploit_hint: As an authorized address, call the performairdrop function with the attacker's address as the 'from' parameter, and specify the attacker's own address in the addresses array with a large token amount in the tokens array. This will transfer tokens from the 'from' address to the attacker's address without proper authorization checks, effectively allowing unauthorized token transfers.
